thread:
Alice Chen: Quick sync — following last night's P0 (paging loop + cache layer failure) we had a few recurring gaps during the handoff and the postmortem creation. I wanted to capture a short proposal for runbook + postmortem tooling improvements and get quick buy-in.

Miguel Torres: +1. I ran the pager, the escalation path worked but the handoff notes were scattered across DMs and the incident channel. Took a while to know who owned the mitigation actions.

Priya Patel: Same. Also customer impact summary was delayed because support didn't have a structured place to drop the impact bullets. We ended up with 3 different summaries. We should standardize a short set of fields.

Jenna Liu: Yep. I pulled together a rough postmortem skeleton last night in Notion but want it automated into our tracker and linked to the incident. Manual copy/paste is the slow part.

Jonah Kim: FWIW the IncidentBot can already create a ticket but doesn't pre-fill customer-impact or handoff notes. We could extend it.

IncidentBot: Automated note: Incident #2026-03-14-P0 created by Alice Chen. Current status: resolved. Summary: latency spike -> cache miss storm -> autoscaler thrash.

Alice Chen: Proposal outline: 1) On-call Handoff checklist (short, actionable) 2) Postmortem template with required fields 3) IncidentBot command to scaffold postmortem + create action items in tracker 4) Action-dashboard view (open items, owner, due date, severity) 5) Small automation: copy handoff notes -> postmortem scaffold

Miguel Torres: For the handoff checklist I'd propose a 7-line checklist in-channel pinned at Handoff time. Something like: who is primary, who is secondary, current hypothesis, mitigation in-flight, customer impact summary, suggested pages to follow up (e.g. infra, db), immediate next action. Keeps it scannable.

Priya Patel: We should add an explicit checkbox for "Are customers impacted? (Y/N)" and if Y, a 1-2 line bullet: affected customers, impact (blocking/downtime/data-loss). Support can paste that into the incident summary.

Jenna Liu: Here's a draft postmortem template I propose we auto-populate (JSON snippet for IncidentBot to fill):

```json
{
  "incident_id": "",
  "severity": "P0/P1",
  "start_time": "",
  "end_time": "",
  "summary": "",
  "customer_impact": "",
  "timeline": "",
  "root_cause": "",
  "mitigation_steps": "",
  "action_items": []
}
```

Jenna Liu: The important bit is forcing the minimal required fields: summary, customer_impact, and at least one action item with owner + due date.

Jonah Kim: Action dashboard — we can add a saved view in the internal infra dashboard with columns: incident_id, action_summary, owner, due, status, tags (runbook/infra/product), linked PR/Jira. Make it the default view for "Incidents -> Open Remediations".

Alice Chen: Automation commands (rough):
  - `/incident scaffold --pm @Jenna --severity P0` -> creates postmortem draft + creates entry in action dashboard
  - `/incident handoff --primary @miguel --secondary @jonah --impact "blocked checkout for 12 customers"` -> pins the handoff checklist and populates the postmortem customer_impact field

Miguel Torres: +1 to those commands. Also add `--snooze` to the bot for follow-ups so we don't forget to check regression tests.

Priya Patel: How do we ensure non-blocking action items actually get tracked? We need an SLA for remediation follow-up: e.g., P0 mitigations must have at least one owner and a 7-day due date or escalate to PM/EM if overdue.

Jenna Liu: Agree. Proposed rule: actions created by IncidentBot default to owner provided or the oncall lead; due date defaults to 7 days for P0, 14 for P1. If no owner assigned in 48h, auto-assign to oncall lead and ping them.

Jonah Kim: Implementation detail: IncidentBot should POST to /api/incidents with payload, and our action-tracker service will create the row. We can reuse the existing webhook namespace. Example cURL: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/incidents \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INCIDENT_BOT_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"incident_id":"2026-03-14-P0","pm":"jenna","customer_impact":"blocked checkout for 12 customers"}'
```

Miguel Torres: We should log the handoff message id in the incident record so the postmortem can link back to the exact Slack message (makes audit easier).

Alice Chen: Quick note on permissions: the IncidentBot will need narrower scope to create issues in action tracker (service account). We must route secrets via KMS and restrict to incident service account only. Security sign-off needed. @EngOpsBot can you add a ticket for IAM changes?

EngOpsBot: Created ticket #OPS-1328: "IncidentBot - service account & KMS keys for action tracker writes". Link: https://jira.internal/browse/OPS-1328

Priya Patel: Postmortem scheduling: post-incident we should auto-schedule a 30-min review within 72 hours. If severity P0, schedule 1 hour. Bot should add a calendar event with agenda and attach the scaffolded postmortem doc.

Jenna Liu: For meetings, agenda bullets: 1) quick impact summary (1 slide) 2) timeline (5-10 min) 3) root cause & evidence 4) remediation plan + owners 5) communication plan for customers. Keep timeboxed.

Jonah Kim: One more feature: allow non-blocking actions to be marked as "deferred" with a reason. That should appear on dashboard but not count as overdue if deferred. Useful for infra backlog prioritization.

Alice Chen: Ok next steps proposal:
  - (A) Implement bot commands `/incident scaffold` and `/incident handoff` — Miguel + Jonah to prototype (ETA 2 weeks)
  - (B) Runbook handoff checklist pinned template — Jenna to draft canonical checklist doc (ETA 3 days)
  - (C) Action-dashboard view + backlog rules — Priya to own dashboard and SLAs (ETA 1 week)
  - (D) IAM + KMS ticket (OPS-1328) — EngOps to complete before deployment

Miguel Torres: I'll take (A) with Jonah. I'll prototype the scaffold payload and send PR to incident-bot repo.

Jonah Kim: I'll add the webhook receiver in action-tracker and draft DB schema for action items.

Jenna Liu: I'll post the checklist in #eng-oncall/handbook and link the canonical Notion page.

Priya Patel: I'll create the dashboard view and add the SLA rules. Will set up Zapier-ish job to ping owners when overdue for now.

Alice Chen: Great — can each of you drop a quick comment in OPS-1328 when you want the KMS creds ready? We should also add a short retro item to the postmortem: "improve handoff visibility".

Miguel Torres: Note: small UX ask — when IncidentBot scaffolds a postmortem, include a direct link button in Slack to "Start postmortem" which opens the doc editor and the action dashboard side-by-side. UX will help adoption.

EngOpsBot: Reminder: OPS-1328 updated with comment from Miguel Torres at 1795128880.

Alice Chen: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a quick PR template for the IncidentBot changes and post the handoff checklist draft in 24h. If no objections, we'll kick off the prototype tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: No objections.

Jenna Liu: lgtm

Jonah Kim: lgtm

Miguel Torres: lgtm.

IncidentBot: Closing note: If you'd like the bot to auto-create postmortems for resolved incidents, reply with `@IncidentBot enable-auto-scaffold` in this thread.

Alice Chen: I'll enable auto-scaffold for the P0/P1 channel after the first prototype is live. Thanks everyone.
